command: ./Scripts/build-app.sh && (pkill -TERM -f "[R]outeWeaver\.app/Contents/MacOS/RouteWeaver" || true; for i in $(seq 1 20); do pgrep -f "[R]outeWeaver\.app/Contents/MacOS/RouteWeaver" >/dev/null || break; sleep 0.1; done; pkill -KILL -f "[R]outeWeaver\.app/Contents/MacOS/RouteWeaver" || true) && open -g ./dist/RouteWeaver.app
services.name: RouteWeaver
stop: pkill -TERM -f "$PWD/dist/RouteWeaver.app/Contents/MacOS/RouteWeaver" || true; for i in $(seq 1 20); do pgrep -f "$PWD/dist/RouteWeaver.app/Contents/MacOS/RouteWeaver" >/dev/null || exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; pkill -KILL -f "$PWD/dist/RouteWeaver.app/Contents/MacOS/RouteWeaver" || true
